thread:
deploy-bot: Initiating canary rollout canary-ptg-9 for prompt-gateway handler /v4/prompt-stream. target traffic 12%. watch logs/dash.

elena: rolling out now. keeping an eye on streaming metrics.

marc: seeing spikes in `stream_disconnect` and 502s for the canary buckets. error rate ~22% on canary.

oncall-bot: Paging @rachel (oncall) — high streaming error rate on prompt-gateway canary :rotating_light:

rachel: joining. link to perf dashboard?

elena: dash: https://internal.redwood/d/pg/streams?view=canary (internal). quick look: canary latency p95 x2, disconnects up.

marc: stack traces point at the new framing handler: `frame_writer.go: line 204: write: broken pipe`, followed by `handler/stream.go:98: failed to upgrade partial stream -> downstream reset`.

qa-bot: synthetic check failed: `/v4/prompt-stream` long-context test returned intermittent RST_STREAM within 7s of connection start.

rachel: we should cut traffic immediately. Fastest option: flip feature flag `prompt_gw_v4_active` to false OR abort the deploy. Which is lower blast radius?

elena: FF flip is quickest and avoids forcing a full rollback while we collect logs. I'll flip then monitor.

rachel: go for it. post the toggle command please.

elena: executing FF flip.

deploy-bot: FLAG UPDATE: prompt_gw_v4_active -> false (by elena) :white_check_mark:

marc: metrics: canary errors dropping within 15s. global streaming success rate back to baseline within ~30s.

rachel: creating incident INC-3347, severity S2. tagging @ops-support.

ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-3347 (creator: rachel). initial impact: streaming sessions briefly disconnected for a subset of users; estimated affected sessions ~1.2% during window.

elena: starting canary abort for canary-ptg-9 as fallback.

deploy-bot: Canary abort initiated (canary-ptg-9) by elena. status: draining replicas.

marc: repro locally with chunked prompt + keepalive: `frame_writer` tries to write > mtu size when a particular header `X-Stream-Framing:v4` is present. repro log: ```frame_writer.go:203: attempted write of 131072 bytes > mtu 65536 -> write error: broken pipe
  at handler/stream.go:98
```

qa-bot: attaching synthetic run output and logs to INC-3347. steps to reproduce included.

rachel: customer impact summary for ticket: brief disconnects on long-running streaming sessions. Support queue shows ~220 tickets opened; many auto-retried and recovered. No evidence of data corruption or exfiltration. Marking incident S2.

elena: follow-ups: 1) add defensive chunking in framing layer to split larger frames, 2) add unit + integration tests for framing with varied MTU and header combos, 3) introduce a canary-only alert for frame errors and RST_STREAM counts.

marc: will open PR `fix/frame-chunking-ptg` with tests. also propose a deploy gating job: run a 10-min long-stream synthetic against canary before ramp >5%.

rachel: handing monitoring to next oncall @marc for 90m. I'll add all the repro snippets and the curl toggle used to the incident. Demobilizing if no regressions.

elena: curl example used: ```curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"prompt_gw_v4_active","value":false}'```

ops-bot: Note added to INC-3347: FF flip timestamp 2469123468, canary abort initiated 2469123495.

marc: ack. I'll follow traces and support queue. attaching initial PR link to the incident once ready.

rachel: closing loop — FF flip performed, canary aborted, customer impact contained to a small percentage of sessions with recovery via client retry. Thanks all :thumbsup:
